scene-03: small line exactly '{{groom_relation_ta}}' (SPELLING CRITICAL: this is the GROOM's line and must read exactly அவர்களின் மகன் — the last word is மகன் (son), letter by letter ம-க-ன், i.e. ம + க + ன+், ending in ன் with a pulli; NEVER மகள் (daughter), never ள் at the end), then a separate small line exactly '{{groom_native_ta}}',

small line exactly '{{bride_relation_ta}}, {{bride_native_ta}}' (SPELLING CRITICAL: the place name மேல்செங்கம் must exactly match this string, letter by letter as Unicode components மே-ல்-செ-ங்-க-ம், i.e. ம+ே + ல+் + ச+ெ + ங+் + க + ம+்; with pulli dots on ல், ங் and ம்; no letter added, dropped or substituted).

small line exactly '{{bride_relation_ta}}' (this is the BRIDE's line, ending in மகள்), then the bride's place name ALONE on its own separate final line, slightly larger and bold, exactly '{{bride_native_ta}}'. SPELLING CRITICAL for மேல்செங்கம்: exactly six letters in three pairs, ம+ே+ல+் / ச+ெ+ங+் / க+ம+் = மே ல் செ ங் க ம். The first letter is மே, with the ே vowel sign written in FRONT (to the left) of ம; the second is ல் with a pulli dot; the third is செ, with the ெ vowel sign in front of ச; the fourth is ங் with a pulli dot (ங, not ன் or ண்); the fifth is a plain full-size க, the same height as the other letters; the sixth is ம் with a pulli dot. Avoid the earlier mistake: do NOT draw any extra small circle, ring, dot or stray mark between க and ம், do NOT shrink or subscript the க, and do not add or drop any letter — the letters ங் க ம் sit side by side at full size with nothing in between.
